def f(I):
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    def bbox(g,v):
        ps=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==v]
        return min(p[0] for p in ps),min(p[1] for p in ps),max(p[0] for p in ps),max(p[1] for p in ps)
    r0,c0,r1,c1=bbox(I,5)
    g=[row[:] for row in I]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==0 and not out[i][j]]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); c0=min(p[1] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    col=2
    while (r1-r0+1)>=2 and (c1-c0+1)>=2:
        # skip when region is 2x2 with col=5? demo2 needs: 4x4 interior -> ring 2, center 2x2 becomes 5
        if col==5:
            break
        for j in range(c0,c1+1): g[r0][j]=col; g[r1][j]=col
        for i in range(r0+1,r1):
            g[i][c0]=col; g[i][c1]=col
        r0+=1; c0+=1; r1-=1; c1-=1
        col=5-col
    return g

def f(I):
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    out=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in (0,W-1):
            if I[i][j]==0: out[i][j]=True
    for j in range(W):
        for i in (0,H-1):
            if I[i][j]==0 and not out[i][j]: out[i][j]=True
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==0 and not out[i][j]]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); c0=min(p[1] for p in pts)
    r1=max(p[0] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    g=[row[:] for row in I]
    col=2
    while True:
        h=r1-r0+1; w=c1-c0+1
        if h<2 or w<2: break
        for j in range(c0,c1+1): g[r0][j]=col; g[r1][j]=col
        for i in range(r0+1,r1):
            g[i][c0]=col; g[i][c1]=col
        r0+=1; c0+=1; r1-=1; c1-=1
        col=5-col
    return g

def f(I):
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    out=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in (0,W-1):
            if I[i][j]==0: out[i][j]=True
    for j in range(W):
        for i in (0,H-1):
            if I[i][j]==0 and not out[i][j]: out[i][j]=True
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==0 and not out[i][j]]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); c0=min(p[1] for p in pts)
    r1=max(p[0] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    g=[row[:] for row in I]
    # fill: alternating nested rings starting col 2; only overwrite 0-cells
    # ring k occupies border of rect(r0+k,c0+k,r1-k,c1-k) with col 2 or 5
    k=0; col=2
    while (r1-r0+1)-2*k>=2 and (c1-c0+1)-2*k>=2:
        for j in range(c0+k,c1-k+1):
            if g[r0+k][j]==0: g[r0+k][j]=col
            if g[r1-k][j]==0: g[r1-k][j]=col
        for i in range(r0+k+1,r1-k):
            if g[i][c0+k]==0: g[i][c0+k]=col
            if g[i][c1-k]==0==0: pass
            if g[i][c1-k]==0: g[i][c1-k]=col
        k+=1
        col=5-col
    return g
